Question 4
?

Find f(x,y) such that ∇f=F, where F(x,y)=(cos⁡(x+y)+y)i+(cos⁡(x+y)+x)j.

a
f(x,y)=sin⁡(x+y)+12x2y+C
b
f(x,y)=sin⁡(x+y)+y2+C
c
f(x,y)=sin⁡(x+y)+x+y+C
d
f(x,y)=sin⁡(x+y)+12x2+12y2+C
e
f(x,y)=sin⁡(x+y)+xy+C
Submit
